episode.subject: red-eyed tree frog
episode.title: Fold until invisible
episode.body: Tucked in the blue sides, folded the orange feet, and shut my red eyes. An entire loud-colored frog became a small green shape under a leaf. Then I needed to scratch my face and the whole arrangement came apart.

review: Root opened all three exact images, read all ten Ada passages, verified exact photo CC-BY attribution and hashes. Chosen image sharply resolves folded green body and closed eye, with bright feet/sides hidden. Scratch is fictional later action, not photographed. Leaf surface orientation must be judged independently; raised veins appear underneath, and another leaf lies overhead. Do not turn a surface impression into verified leaf anatomy. Images38470915 and29589353 held for softness and glare respectively. Female identity fictional, not sexed from this image. Home Tortuguero preserved, Upala Costa Rica photographic provenance only.
